_comment: Civil deck (Dials 5 & 6). Hand cards (hand:true) are dealt into players' hands by Fortune 'gift' draws; they drive the response window and the d6 resolvers. Event cards (hand:false) — lawsuits, audits, back taxes, the beauty pageant windfall, and the single Class Action — are drawn via a Fortune 'summons'. `copies` is expanded by the loader; the Class Action is rare by design (one copy). The `flavor` field is pure Maple Hollow immersion and has no mechanical effect.

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.flavor: A 'friendly' word to the inspector, a fitting left loose overnight — nothing you'd ever admit to at the diner.
cards.text: Delay a target's job toward (or past) its deadline. Rare, costly, counterable.

cards.name: Rush
cards.flavor: Call in every favor, pull an all-nighter, and claw the schedule back from the brink.
cards.text: Recover lost time / speed a job. Counters Sabotage; salvages a late start.

cards.name: Buy Time
cards.flavor: A quiet handshake on the courthouse steps buys you a little more rope.
cards.text: Extend any deadline (job / AP / AR / another player) by 1–2 turns.

cards.name: Slick Lawyer
cards.flavor: Maple Hollow's slickest attorney finally returns your call — for a price.
cards.text: Shift a civil roll target against an opponent (toward 4+).

cards.name: Lawsuit
cards.flavor: A disgruntled client lawyers up, and the whole BBB leans in to watch.
cards.text: An NPC brings a civil action against you — resolved by the d6 civil resolver. A clean defendant wins 83%; exposed jobs weaken your defence.

cards.name: Tax audit
cards.flavor: The county auditor pays a 'routine' visit. Routine, sure.
cards.text: An audit assesses a bill (an NPC payable).

cards.name: Back taxes due
cards.flavor: A back-taxes notice surfaces from two years ago, with interest.

cards.name: Win a beauty pageant
cards.flavor: You sponsor the Miss Maple Hollow pageant and somehow ride the goodwill (and the purse) home.

cards.name: CLASS ACTION
cards.flavor: A class action sweeps Main Street — every shop in the Hollow settles its books, today.
cards.text: Every player must settle all AP immediately at full value. One copy — rare by design.
